findings.title: getImage() is presented as the mechanism for OG/Twitter image resolution, but the official Astro blog template's own BaseHead.astro does not use it
findings.location: design.md section 4, "OG/Twitter image resolution for per-post heroImage" bullet
findings.detail: Verified against the live withastro/astro repo: examples/blog/src/components/BaseHead.astro takes an `image?: ImageMetadata` prop and resolves it with `new URL(image.src, Astro.url)`, with no getImage() call. getImage() from astro:assets is real and documented, and is a valid way to resolve a content-collection image() field to a URL, but it is not strictly necessary here since the field already resolves to the same ImageMetadata shape the template's own prop expects, and `.src` would work directly in the common case.
findings.fix: Soften the wording to present heroImage.src (matching the official template's own BaseHead.astro pattern) as the simpler option, with getImage({ src: heroImage }) as an alternative if format control for the OG image specifically is wanted.
